text.p: (Millions of dollars, except per share data)

NOTES: (a) Results for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 1997, include a $37 million and $60 million decrease, respectively, in Sales; an $11 million and $17 million decrease, respectively, in Operating profit; and, a $5 million and $10 million decrease, respectively, in Net income from currency translation effects worldwide as compared to the 1996 results.
(b) The quarter and six months ended June 30, 1997, includes $6 million and $10 million, respectively, in Selling, general and administrative costs associated with acquisitions other than CBI.
(c) The 1996 CBI integration charges are related to the integration of CBI's Liquid Carbonic business into Praxair; primarily severance and lease termination costs.
(d) Excluding the effect of the first quarter CBI integration charges, income taxes for the six months ended June 30, 1996 were $67 million (27.3% effective tax rate).
(e) Based on 164,541,606 and 164,471,563 shares for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 1997 (161,680,019 and 155,080,980 shares for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 1996).
